items.title: Ukraine war: Merz doubts Russia is serious about a truce
items.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz met with Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Berlin. Both leaders said the EU needs to be included in peace talks with Russia. Merz also expressed doubts that Russia is serious about seeking a truce.

items.title: What US midterm elections mean for Ukraine, Iran and elsewhere
items.description: Donald Trump's Republicans control the US Congress, but that could change after the midterm elections. The outcome of the ballot will not only impact domestic policy but also conflicts in Europe and the Middle East.

items.title: Germany news: Ukraine in focus at Berlin Security Conference
items.description: A security conference in the German capital is addressing defending Europe against threats from Russia. Meanwhile, Germany's justice minister wants to raise penalties for sexual offenses. DW has more.

sections.title: Beyond Climate & EU — World News Highlights

items.title: Seven flights across Europe targeted by suspected bomb threats
items.description: Planes in Poland, Spain, Bulgaria and Italy have been checked for explosives following separate threats.

items.title: Europe on alert after supermarket freezers hit by cyber-attacks in 10 countries
items.description: Supermarkets have reported problems from Estonia and Sweden to Portugal and Italy and many retainers have been forced to discard food.

items.title: Multiple flights to European airports targeted by bomb threats
items.description: The bomb threats involved two passenger planes bound for Warsaw, a Ryanair flight from London to Spain, and a fourth flight traveling from Israel to the Bulgarian capital, Sofia. No explosives were found.

items.title: Could the AI boom make borrowing more expensive in Europe?
items.description: France, Germany and Italy face a volatile bond market as war inflation bites. With US tech giants now issuing billions in AI bonds, they are competing with cash-strapped European governments.
